title: Influence under constant bias
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, $p\in(0,1)$, $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $i$ be a coordinate. When every coordinate has bias $p$, the expected conditional variance of $f$ at coordinate $i$ under the heterogeneous product distribution equals the product-measure influence at coordinate $i$ for the common biased sign distribution.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
